title: Agent Tools and Capabilities
summary: This module defines and manages various capabilities and tools that can be integrated into an AI agent. It provides mechanisms for tool discovery, execution, lifecycle hooks, and native/local tool handling.

nodes.label: Define Agent Capability
nodes.title: AbstractCapability
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all agent capabilities, providing a common interface for defining agent behavior, instructions, model settings, tools, and request/response hooks.

nodes.label: Specify Capability Schema
nodes.title: CapabilitySpec
nodes.description: A specification for capabilities, used for schema generation to ensure proper serialization and deserialization of capability configurations within agent specifications.

nodes.label: Wrap Agent Capability
nodes.title: WrapperCapability
nodes.description: A capability that wraps another capability, delegating all methods to the wrapped instance. It allows for modifying specific behaviors while reusing the core functionality of an existing capability.

nodes.label: Register Agent Hooks
nodes.title: Hooks
nodes.description: A flexible capability for registering custom hook functions at various points in the agent's lifecycle, enabling dynamic adjustments and logging without subclassing AbstractCapability directly.

nodes.label: Handle Deferred Tool Calls
nodes.title: HandleDeferredToolCalls
nodes.description: A capability that intercepts and resolves deferred tool calls (e.g., those requiring approval or external execution) using a user-provided handler, allowing the agent run to continue automatically.

nodes.label: Instrument Agent Runs
nodes.title: Instrumentation
nodes.description: Provides OpenTelemetry/Logfire tracing for agent runs, model requests, and tool executions. It creates detailed spans to monitor and debug the agent's internal operations and performance.

nodes.label: Process Agent Event Stream
nodes.title: ProcessEventStream
nodes.description: Forwards the agent's event stream to a user-provided asynchronous handler or processor, allowing for observation, modification, or filtering of events during model streaming and tool execution.

nodes.label: Manage Thread Pool
nodes.title: ThreadExecutor
nodes.description: Allows the use of a custom thread pool executor for running synchronous functions, preventing thread accumulation in long-running servers and optimizing resource management.

nodes.label: Discover Agent Tools
nodes.title: ToolSearch
nodes.description: Enables tool discovery for large toolsets, especially for tools marked with `defer_loading=True`. It supports native model-based search or local keyword matching algorithms.

nodes.label: Manage Native/Local Tools
nodes.title: NativeOrLocalTool
nodes.description: A capability that pairs a provider-native tool with a local fallback. It dynamically selects the appropriate tool based on model support, ensuring robust tool availability.

nodes.label: Include Tool Return Schemas
nodes.title: IncludeToolReturnSchemas
nodes.description: Includes return schemas for selected tools, providing models with type information for tool outputs. This enhances the model's ability to understand and utilize tool results effectively.

nodes.label: Set Tool Metadata
nodes.title: SetToolMetadata
nodes.description: Merges custom metadata key-value pairs onto selected tools, allowing for additional context or configuration to be associated with tool definitions for agent consumption.

nodes.label: Order Capabilities
nodes.title: sort_capabilities
nodes.description: A utility function that sorts capabilities based on their declared ordering constraints, ensuring that dependencies and positional requirements are met during agent initialization.

nodes.label: Narrow Native Tool Search Call
nodes.title: _narrow_native_tool_search_call
nodes.description: A helper function that narrows a native tool call part to a specific native tool search call part, validating and transforming arguments for tool search operations.

nodes.label: Narrow Native Tool Search Return
nodes.title: _narrow_native_tool_search_return
nodes.description: A helper function that narrows a native tool return part to a specific native tool search return part, validating and transforming content for tool search results.

nodes.label: Narrow Tool Search Call
nodes.title: _narrow_tool_search_call
nodes.description: A helper function that narrows a generic tool call part to a specific tool search call part, validating and transforming arguments for tool search operations.

nodes.label: Narrow Tool Search Return
nodes.title: _narrow_tool_search_return
nodes.description: A helper function that narrows a generic tool return part to a specific tool search return part, validating and transforming content for tool search results.

nodes.label: Perform Keyword Search
nodes.title: keywords_search_fn
nodes.description: A built-in keyword-overlap search algorithm used for tool discovery. It scores tools based on keyword matches in their names and descriptions, returning relevant tools.

nodes.label: Perform Web Search
nodes.title: WebSearch
nodes.description: A capability for performing web searches, utilizing either the model's native web search functionality or falling back to a local function tool like DuckDuckGo.

nodes.label: Fetch Web Content
nodes.title: WebFetch
nodes.description: A capability for fetching content from URLs, using the model's native URL fetching or a local markdownify-based fallback. It supports domain filtering and content limits.

nodes.label: Interact with MCP Server
nodes.title: MCP
nodes.description: A capability for interacting with an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, leveraging native model support or connecting directly via HTTP for tool execution and instruction retrieval.

nodes.label: Configure Model Thinking
nodes.title: Thinking
nodes.description: Enables and configures the model's thinking or reasoning process. It uses a unified `thinking` setting to work across different providers, allowing for various effort levels.

nodes.label: Define Tool Collection
nodes.title: AbstractToolset
nodes.description: An abstract base class for collections of tools, responsible for listing available tools, validating their arguments, and executing them. It forms the foundation for organizing agent functionalities.

nodes.label: Wrap Tool Collection
nodes.title: WrapperToolset
nodes.description: A toolset that wraps another toolset, delegating all method calls to the wrapped instance. This allows for modifying or extending toolset behavior without altering the original toolset.

nodes.label: Integrate FastMCP Tools
nodes.title: FastMCPToolset
nodes.description: A toolset that integrates tools from a FastMCP server, using a FastMCP client to call tools locally or remotely. It manages server connection and tool execution.

nodes.label: Integrate Exa Search Tools
nodes.title: ExaToolset
nodes.description: A toolset providing Exa search tools (search, find_similar, get_contents, answer) with a shared client. This optimizes efficiency when using multiple Exa-related functionalities.

nodes.label: Create Tavily Search Tool
nodes.title: tavily_search_tool
nodes.description: A function that creates a Tavily search tool, allowing agents to perform web searches using the Tavily API. It supports various search parameters and result filtering.

nodes.label: Manage External Tools
nodes.title: DeferredToolset
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for `ExternalToolset`, representing a toolset whose tools are managed externally or require deferred loading and execution.

nodes.label: Enable Code Execution
nodes.title: CodeExecutionTool
nodes.description: A native tool that allows the agent to execute code. Supported by various models, it provides a powerful capability for dynamic problem-solving and interaction.

nodes.label: Enable Agent Memory
nodes.title: MemoryTool
nodes.description: A native tool that allows the agent to utilize memory. This capability is crucial for maintaining context and state across multiple turns in a conversation or task.

nodes.label: Enable File Search
nodes.title: FileSearchTool
nodes.description: A native tool enabling agents to search through uploaded files using vector search. It provides a fully managed RAG system for efficient information retrieval from documents.

nodes.label: Enable URL Context
nodes.title: UrlContextTool
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for `WebFetchTool`, used for backward compatibility. It represents a native tool for fetching and processing content from URLs.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Tool Execution
nodes.title: ToolManager
nodes.description: Manages the entire lifecycle of tool calls for an agent run step, including caching tool definitions, validating arguments, executing tools, handling retries, and integrating with capability hooks.

nodes.label: AI Agent
nodes.title: AI Agent
nodes.description: The core AI agent component that orchestrates interactions, manages state, and utilizes capabilities and tools to achieve its goals.

nodes.label: Agent Run Context
nodes.title: RunContext
nodes.description: Provides contextual information for the current agent run, including messages, dependencies, and retry counts, enabling capabilities and tools to operate within the run's scope.

nodes.label: Tool Call Part
nodes.title: ToolCallPart
nodes.description: Represents a part of a tool call message, containing the tool's name and arguments, as generated by the model or provided for execution.

nodes.label: Abstract Native Tool
nodes.title: AbstractNativeTool
nodes.description: The base class for native tools, which are directly supported and executed by the underlying AI model provider.

nodes.label: Exa API Client
nodes.title: AsyncExa
nodes.description: An asynchronous client for interacting with the Exa search API, used by the ExaToolset to perform various search operations.

nodes.label: Tavily API Client
nodes.title: AsyncTavilyClient
nodes.description: An asynchronous client for interacting with the Tavily search API, used by the tavily_search_tool to perform web searches.

nodes.label: FastMCP Client
nodes.title: FastMCP Client
nodes.description: The client library for the FastMCP protocol, used by FastMCPToolset to communicate with and utilize tools from an MCP server.

groups.label: Capability Base & Structure
groups.title: Capability Base & Structure
groups.description: Defines the foundational interfaces and structural components for building and extending agent capabilities, including abstract definitions and wrapper patterns.

groups.label: Agent Lifecycle Hooks
groups.title: Agent Lifecycle Hooks
groups.description: Provides mechanisms for injecting custom logic at various stages of an agent's execution, from run initiation to tool execution and event stream processing.

groups.label: Tool Discovery & Management
groups.title: Tool Discovery & Management
groups.description: Focuses on finding, organizing, and preparing tools for agent use, including search algorithms, metadata handling, and schema inclusion.

groups.label: Specific Capabilities
groups.title: Specific Capabilities
groups.description: Implements concrete, high-level functionalities for agents, such as web interaction, external server communication, and model behavior configuration.

groups.label: Toolset Base & Implementations
groups.title: Toolset Base & Implementations
groups.description: Establishes the framework for grouping and managing collections of tools, offering various concrete implementations for different external services or wrapping patterns.

groups.label: Native Tool Types
groups.title: Native Tool Types
groups.description: Represents the built-in, platform-specific tools that AI models can directly invoke, covering functionalities like code execution, memory access, and file searching.

groups.label: Tool Execution Orchestration
groups.title: Tool Execution Orchestration
groups.description: Manages the entire lifecycle of tool calls, including argument validation, execution, error handling, and integration with agent lifecycle hooks.
